mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in FEDFUNDS over the past 6 months signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS tightening, or FEDFUNDS shows a downward trend instead of upward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in UNRATE over the past 3 months indicates weakening labor market conditions, raising inflation expectations and reducing corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) during periods of rising UNRATE, or UNRATE shows a downward trend instead of upward.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in GDPC1 above 19000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) during periods of GDPC1 exceeding 19000, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 indicates conflicting policy and demand pressures; rising rates compress discount rates while strong demand supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) when both proxies move in tandem, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained increases in FEDFUNDS above 0.15% signal an impending tightening, prompting market anticipation of a recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) during late-cycle expansion with FEDFUNDS > 0.15%, or the regime does not hold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their 5-year averages signals robust demand across sectors, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) when both proxies rise above their averages, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in INDPRO below 100 signals weakening supply-side growth, raising inflation concerns and reducing market optimism, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) during periods of INDPRO below 100, or the drop is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle regime, sustained increases in FEDFUNDS above 1.0% signal aggressive policy, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS above 1.0% in a tightening cycle, or the regime does not hold.
